_meta.hard_rule: A fix is 'fixed' ONLY when its full business-chain spec passes end-to-end - never an isolated probe. (B1, 2026-06-09, was falsely declared fixed off a single-insert probe; only the full return->credit->statement->unapply chain exposed the stacked breaks.)
_meta.pass_signal: Every chain is a single DO block that ALWAYS terminates with RAISE EXCEPTION 'SMOKE_PASS_ROLLBACK'. That exact error text = PASS (and guarantees rollback). ANY other error = FAIL.
_meta.spec_contract: Keys are the primary RPC under test. 'covers' lists every RPC the chain exercises - run-smoke.mjs --spec <rpc> matches keys AND covers entries, so one chain can certify several RPCs. Every migration that touches an RPC must have or extend a spec covering it.

remaining_money_inventory_hardening.description: Final money/inventory audit chain: voided orders disappear from detail, summary, gross-sales, and finance-dashboard revenue; inactive sales/admin profiles are rejected; only an active admin can use the PO over-receive flag, NULL cannot bypass the quantity ceiling, and a real admin 11-against-10 receipt succeeds; anonymous gross-sales execution and authenticated direct payment-table writes are absent. Self-contained fixtures and terminal rollback.

stage_offline_action.description: Permanent offline receipt chain: complete_delivery and complete_job stage -> immutable canonical replay -> canonical process -> durable sanitized status -> replay without duplicate inventory/application work; actor-bound processing; owner and office status visibility; missing-target and unauthorized-action retention; deterministic state-conflict review; sanitized office queue; audited, idempotent manual resolution; RPC-only writes; grants. Self-contained fixtures and terminal rollback.

set_field_boundary.description: Field-acre-billing acreage RPCs (migrations 20260623120000/130000): a ~40-ac polygon measures sane geodesic acres (acres_source='measured'); the 0.1-5000 band rejects oversize (AREA_OUT_OF_BAND); a typed override SURVIVES a redraw (set_field_boundary never touches override_acres); idempotent replay returns the same result; the fields_acre_authority trigger blocks a direct measured_acres write.

save_job.description: Field-app parity #1 (migration 20260624120000): the extended save_job round-trips scheduling dates (call/proposed/schedule/expires + time_proposed), consultant, three memo fields, per-field agronomy (planted_acres/crop/strip/pests), per-field customer shares, and chemical extras (diluent_rate/rei_hours/phi_days/warehouse/vendor); remaining_acres GENERATED = total - applied; field shares not totalling 100 raise SHARE_NOT_100; idempotent replay returns the same job_id with no second job; a forged p_performed_by raises ACTOR_MISMATCH.

save_quote.description: Drawn-product edit guard (A4): reducing a booking below its drawn quantity and removing a drawn product both raise BOOKING_OVERDRAWN; a legal reduce keeps booked/drawn/status consistent and the booking still closes at the new total; a no-draws control quote edits freely.

rollover_quote_to_season.description: Remainder-only season rollover (A5): 500-booked/200-drawn rolls over exactly 300 with FIFO consumption across split items and acre proration; fully-drawn raises BOOKING_FULLY_DRAWN; no-draws rollover preserves live copy behavior (total_units_needed stays NULL).

auto_expire_quotes.description: Expiry sweep skips partially-drawn bookings past expires_at, still expires an undrawn control quote, completes despite the best-effort activity_feed summary, and re-asserts the 20260609203541 grant hardening (no authenticated/anon EXECUTE).

void_order.description: Draw-ledger reversal on void/cancel: voiding a partial draw order restores the booking balance (re-draw works); cancelling a draw order restores the ledger but preserves the open booking's active hold (F7 skip); voiding the FINAL draw reopens an accepted booking ('booking_reopened' activity) and re-draw re-accepts; whole-conversion void leaves the booking closed; double-void/re-cancel guards hold.

issue_return_credit.description: THE canonical return->credit chain: create_return derives immutable lines from delivered order items -> parent source retarget is blocked -> approve -> receive/restock -> void/cancel refuse the received return even with non-restock line flags -> issue a posted credit memo -> stable replay -> statement single-count -> unapply -> re-issue; only the exact verified production source-free RMA remains finishable while every other source-free row is rejected even if backdated.

batch_apply_prepayments.description: Batch-prepay boundary: active non-admin denied, forged actor denied, active admin positive control succeeds, replay is stable, blank idempotency keys are rejected by both shared helpers, and the shared transaction advisory lock is present.

complete_cycle_count.description: Cycle-count complete/reverse chain: quantity changes 100->112->100, both replays are stable, lifecycle states advance correctly, and both wrappers retain inventory row locks.

update_order_items.description: Draw-order item lock (Codex r2 HIGH): editing items on a booking_draw order raises BOOKING_DRAW_ORDER_LOCKED (qty change AND add-item) with order+ledger intact, the remaining balance still draws to closure, and a whole-conversion control order (booking_draw=false) edits freely.

restore_quote_version.description: Drawn-version restore guard (Codex r2 MED): restoring a snapshot below the drawn ledger raises BOOKING_OVERDRAWN (fall-below AND removes branches; the restore's section DELETE rolls back atomically), a legal restore (>= drawn) succeeds to 'revised' with the ledger intact and then draws to closure, and a no-draws control quote restores freely.

get_customer_statement.description: Statement blind-spot fix (CHIP task_25d25699, migration 20260611131549): legacy, NULL-order, and allocation-set payments each appear exactly once; paid/overdue invoices keep their charge lines; soft-deleted payments excluded; credit memo single-count; unapplied overpayment prepay NOT pre-counted (DEDUP RULE); idempotent allocate_payment replay does not double-count; running balance never negative; unknown-actor auth probe rejected by the in-body gate.

create_planned_holds.description: Authoritative planned-hold sync (Codex r2 #3, migration 20260611132115): active holds always equal booked − drawn per product after create_planned_holds, save_quote (Draft/Revise/Present), and restore_quote_version, with FIFO consumption so per-item expiry (needed_by+14d) follows the still-reserved tail; rebuild-after-draw no longer re-reserves drawn quantity; is_planned switched off + save releases all holds server-side.

draw_down_quote.description: Standard 4-probe auth set, worked example against draw_down_quote: no-auth -> AUTH_REQUIRED; anon-key -> AUTH_REQUIRED with zero rows written; wrong-role (driver/applicator) -> INSUFFICIENT_ROLE; forged p_performed_by -> ACTOR_MISMATCH; plus a positive admin control draw proving the probes failed for the right reason. File header documents the placeholders for adapting it to any new RPC.

create_direct_order.description: Customer-PO param (migration 20260614130000): a REAL active sales_rep creates a direct order WITH p_customer_po_number and the PO persists on orders (the bug: the old frontend post-create orders.update() hit the admin-only orders_update RLS and failed for sales_rep). Asserts order/order_items/inventory-prebook created, status confirmed; whitespace PO normalizes to NULL; idempotency replay returns the same order with no duplicate; plus the auth probes (no-auth -> Authentication required, driver -> INSUFFICIENT_ROLE, forged actor -> Actor mismatch).

load_recipe_into_job.description: Recipe per-unit pricing BUNDLE (Phase 4, REQUIRES 20260618230000 + 20260619150000): save_blend_recipe persists price_per_unit_cents on create AND keeps it on edit (no wipe — Codex Phase-4 P2); load_recipe_into_job seeds job_chemicals.price_per_unit_cents from it; a negative price is rejected. Pre-apply the chain FAILS (live save_blend_recipe drops the column).

save_field_app_invoice.description: Field-app parity and save/post serialization: a multi-customer field auto-splits into ONE invoice PER billing customer sharing an invoice_group_id; the split is PENNY-EXACT on an INDIVISIBLE total (price 1501c, rate 0.01, 1/3-2/3 split -> A=500c + B=1001c = 1501c odd); invoice_shares and acres tie exactly; an idempotent retry creates no duplicate; save/group-post serialize on the immutable group ID before ordered row locking; and a save after real group posting is rejected before invoice lines can change.

save_invoice.description: save_invoice field-application aware (#3 edit-path, REQUIRES 20260619160000): editing a field_application invoice PRESERVES the is_application_fee machine-fee line + re-balances the per-grower invoice_shares to the new total; a chemical_sale invoice's shares are NOT touched (field-only guard). Pre-apply the chain FAILS (live save_invoice drops the fee flag + never touches shares).

fuel_surcharge.description: Field-app parity #32 (REQUIRES 20260625140000): fuel surcharge is OFF by default and inert. Proves: with app_settings.fuel_surcharge at the shipped default (enabled=false, rate blank) a saved field-app invoice has NO 'Fuel Surcharge' line and the total is the pure pre-surcharge sum (DEFAULT-OFF INERT); after an admin sets enabled=true + a TEST per-acre rate, a re-save adds EXACTLY ONE is_application_fee 'Fuel Surcharge' line of ROUND(rate*100*acres) cents and the total rises by EXACTLY that amount (no drift); the surcharge flows into invoice_shares.amount_cents (share split / print); and enabled+BLANK rate produces NO line (off-if-formula-blank). The config writes are inside the rolled-back txn so the persisted OFF default is never changed. NEVER invents a rate.

transfer_job_to_invoice.description: Job->field-invoice billing (REQUIRES 20260619140000): forged actor -> ACTOR_MISMATCH (G3); a job with application_service_id gets ONE is_application_fee line (price_source 'tier') + the service FK on the invoice; a FLAT/unrated chemical line still bills; per-customer fee rate in split jobs (a grower's customer_application_rates override is honored — Codex P1); totals + shares reconcile in single / same-rate-split / different-rate-split cases. Pre-apply the chain FAILS (live body has no fee line). NOTE: the prior full start_job->complete->post->void loop chain file is absent; this chain certifies transfer_job_to_invoice's fee+actor behavior.

transfer_invoice_to_job.description: #27 reverse leg (REQUIRES 20260625120000): full job<->invoice round-trip. transfer_job_to_invoice creates the unposted invoice (job invoiced + invoice_id set + per-customer shares + application_records linked), then transfer_invoice_to_job reverses it (invoice -> cancelled, items+shares deleted, application_records.invoice_id cleared, job invoiced -> completed, jobs.invoice_id NULL, one invoice_cancelled audit row). Proves: forged actor -> ACTOR_MISMATCH (no mutation); idempotent replay (same key -> saved result, no 2nd audit row); the returned job re-transfers to a NEW invoice; a POSTED invoice is refused ('Only a draft or unposted invoice...'); an engine-built field invoice with no job_id is refused.

unpost_invoice.description: #28 unpost leg (REQUIRES 20260625130000): post->unpost round-trip on a field_application invoice. post_invoice posts a draft (posted_by/at stamped, invoice_posted audit row); unpost_invoice reverses it (posted|overdue -> unposted, posted_by/at cleared, money fields untouched, one append-only invoice_unposted audit row, post row preserved). Proves: forged actor -> ACTOR_MISMATCH (no mutation); idempotent replay (same key -> saved result, no 2nd audit row); re-post after unpost works; MONEY GUARD refuses a posted invoice with an allocated payment + paid_amount_cents (status unchanged, allocation intact, no audit row); STATUS GUARD refuses a never-posted draft ('nothing to unpost'); PERIOD GUARD refuses a posted invoice in a CLOSED accounting period (status unchanged); an 'overdue' invoice unposts (superset of posted).

dispatch_job_locations.description: Field-app parity #36 (REQUIRES 20260626120000): per-location dispatch wizard commit. Proves through the REAL dispatch_job_locations RPC + the new job_location_dispatches table: MULTI-APPLICATOR SPLIT (location A->applicator 1 and location B->applicator 2 in one call -> {dispatched:2}, two rows with DIFFERENT applicators); IDEMPOTENCY (same key -> same result, no new rows); RE-DISPATCH UPSERT (re-dispatching a location to a crew REPLACES its row in place, never duplicates); XOR GUARD (both-assignee and neither-assignee both raise ONE_ASSIGNEE_REQUIRED); ROLE GATE (an applicator caller -> INSUFFICIENT_ROLE); ACTOR GATE (forged p_performed_by -> ACTOR_MISMATCH); LIFECYCLE GATE (a location on a cancelled job -> JOB_NOT_DISPATCHABLE); RLS READ (the dispatched applicator can SELECT their own row though not the whole-job applicator); RLS WRITE — RPC-ONLY (neither an applicator NOR an admin can directly INSERT; the SECURITY DEFINER RPC is the sole write path); LICENSE GATE (an applicator with an all-expired active license -> LICENSE_EXPIRED, admin p_license_override succeeds); CREW-MEMBER RLS READ (a member of the dispatched crew can read the crew dispatch row AND the parent job AND its job_fields); PER-LOCATION-APPLICATOR JOB READ (a per-location-only assignee can read the parent job via jobs_select_location_dispatchee — the recursion-safe _is_dispatched_to_me helper breaks the jobs<->dispatches policy cycle); CANCELLED-DISPATCH VISIBILITY REVOKE (a cancelled dispatch no longer surfaces the row/job/fields to the former assignee); LICENSE-OVERRIDE AUDIT (an actual override writes a job_location_dispatched activity_feed row + returns license_overrides count); FK CASCADE (deleting an assignee cascades the dispatch row, never failing the XOR check); CUSTOMER RLS READ (a per-location assignee can read the job's embedded customer); SOFT-DELETED JOB rejected (the RLS-bypassing RPC requires deleted_at IS NULL → JOB_NOT_FOUND); ACTIVITY LOG (every normal dispatch — not just overrides — writes a job_location_dispatched activity_feed row, restoring the audit trail); DEACTIVATED ASSIGNEE LOSES VISIBILITY (the is_active re-check in _is_dispatched_to_me + the SELECT policy revokes a deactivated user's dispatch/job read even with a live token). Self-contained fixtures.

undispatch_job_locations.description: Field-app parity #37 (REQUIRES 20260626120000 + 20260626140000): Dispatched List + reassign/undispatch. Proves through the REAL undispatch_job_locations + get_dispatched_list RPCs (+ dispatch_job_locations for reassign): SETUP/LIST (dispatch loc A->app1, loc B->app2; get_dispatched_list returns both rows fully shaped — assignee name resolved server-side, job#, field name, status, location + job acres); ASSIGNEE FILTER (get_dispatched_list(app1) returns only loc A); REASSIGN (dispatch_job_locations re-dispatches loc A->app2 as an upsert; the list shows loc A under app2, no duplicate, no longer under app1); UNDISPATCH (undispatch_job_locations([loc B]) -> {undispatched:1}, the row's dispatch_status='cancelled', the list drops loc B, an activity_feed audit row is written); UNDISPATCH REVOKES VISIBILITY (the former assignee can no longer SELECT the cancelled dispatch row); ROLE GATE (an applicator caller -> INSUFFICIENT_ROLE); ACTOR GATE (forged p_performed_by -> ACTOR_MISMATCH); IDEMPOTENCY (replaying the same undispatch key -> same result, cancels nothing new); NO-OP UNDISPATCH (undispatching a never-dispatched location -> {undispatched:0}, not an error); ANON DENIED (anon has no EXECUTE on either new fn). Self-contained fixtures.

unpost_invoice_group.description: Field-app remediation Wave 2a FIX 4 (REQUIRES 20260629170000): ALL-OR-NOTHING split-group unpost. Proves through the REAL unpost_invoice_group: HAPPY (a posted 2-member split group unposts in ONE call — both members posted->unposted, posted_by/at cleared, one invoice_unposted audit row per member, one invoice_group_unposted activity row); ALL-OR-NOTHING (a posted group where one member is PAID/money-applied -> the whole call RAISES the money-guard error and NOTHING changes — both still posted, 0 unpost audit rows; no half-unpost reachable); ROLE GATE (an applicator caller -> 'admin or sales role required'); ACTOR GATE (forged p_performed_by -> ACTOR_MISMATCH, no mutation); GRANTS (anon has NO EXECUTE, authenticated does). Self-contained fixtures.

get_jobs_billed_customers.description: Field-app remediation Wave 2a FIX 2 (REQUIRES 20260629160000): batched, RLS-safe billed-customer resolver for the jobs list. Proves through the REAL get_jobs_billed_customers vs get_job_billed_customers: PARITY (as an applicator on a split job, the batch resolver returns the SAME customer_id set as the per-job resolver — exactly {primary A, co-billed B}); CO-BILLED VISIBLE (the co-billed split owner B IS returned to the applicator, the bug being that the job_field_shares.customer RLS embed dropped B; exactly one is_primary row); GRANTS (anon has NO EXECUTE, authenticated does). Self-contained fixtures.

job_applied_record_fields_rls.description: Field-app remediation Wave 2a FIX 1 (REQUIRES 20260629150000): field-membership RLS on job_applied_record_fields INSERT/UPDATE. Proves with a sales_rep under RLS (role authenticated): REJECT (inserting a row whose field_id is NOT one of the parent record's job fields fails the WITH CHECK — row-level security violation); ACCEPT (an in-job field_id inserts cleanly, exactly one row, no foreign row); UPDATE REJECT (moving the legit row's field_id onto a foreign field fails the WITH CHECK; the row stays on the in-job field). Self-contained fixtures. (Policy-only migration; no callable RPC — the covers token below is the TABLE name so `--spec job_applied_record_fields` resolves this chain.)

enforce_billed_job_immutability.description: Field-app parity #12 + P1 remediation (REQUIRES 20260625190000 & 20260629120000): regression guard for the _enforce_billed_job_immutability BEFORE-UPDATE trigger on jobs. Proves with a sales_rep under RLS (role authenticated) on an INVOICED job: BLOCKED — soft-delete (deleted_at NULL->non-NULL) RAISES 'cannot be deleted by a non-admin'; rewrite total_price_cents RAISES 'cannot edit its billed-relevant fields'; rewrite invoice_id->NULL (detach) and invoice_id->other (repoint) BOTH RAISE the same (the P1 remediation closing the invoice_id hole); and a sanity check that no blocked path leaked a mutation. EXEMPT — printed_at/last_printed_by (print audit), applied_acres (as-applied recompute), updated_at/updated_by (bookkeeping) all SUCCEED for the non-admin. HATCH — an ADMIN (jwt sub=admin, is_admin()=true) CAN correct total_price_cents; the app.admin_override='true' definer-flow hatch lets an otherwise-blocked non-admin write through. LEGIT WRITERS — transfer_job_to_invoice (writes jobs.invoice_id while status='completed', guard early-returns) and transfer_invoice_to_job (clears invoice_id under the override hatch) both still succeed. Self-contained fixtures; ends in SMOKE_PASS_ROLLBACK. (Trigger-only migration; the covers token is the trigger/function name so `--spec enforce_billed_job_immutability` resolves this chain.)
